prompt_en: Photograph a connected horror scene in brilliant rural daylight. The main subject is a woman whose facial and hair appearance follows the supplied portrait, rendered as a fictional adult traveler with a short dark bob, wispy bangs, dark eyes and softly rounded features. A visible threat interrupts her attempted departure. She has just returned a small brass passage token, expecting the way home to open, and now sees the community closing that way instead. In a remote pear-orchard drying courtyard, a sun-bleached square threshing floor is enclosed by dense green tree rows; one narrow lane through the trees is the only open route to the distant approach road. The traveler occupies the near left of the frame, her torso angled toward a threshold keeper and her three-quarter face turned toward the exit beyond. Her bare right hand hangs palm-down above a shallow unglazed clay dish on a waist-high pale ashwood stand, the brass token resting directly beneath her fingertips. Her left hand holds the handle of a small travel bag beside her thigh; both feet remain planted on the dusty floor, her weight shifting back. The keeper slides the dish inward toward the assembled community while watching her hovering hand. Behind the keeper, adults in coarse cream linen form a broad inward-facing arc across the courtyard. Its final member is caught in a lateral step into the last human gap, directly in line with the exit lane. Two attendants at that lane pull a thick flax rope taut between waist-high posts across the path. The other faces are calmly turned toward the traveler, their ordinary hospitality held with an unsettling precision. Her parted lips, tightened brow and small backward lean answer the vanished opening. The token transaction, closing human line and tensioned rope belong to the same event. Use an oblique eye-level medium-wide photograph, with her face and suspended hand clear in the foreground and the complete lane closure legible behind her. Her luminous skin and softly glossy lips retain a subtle intimate presence against the group's severe geometry. Hard white midday sun reveals rough linen, dry dust, ashwood grain and the rope's twisted fibres; straw-yellow cloth at the posts and a lucid pale-blue sky make the exposed scene beautiful and inescapable. Keep the traveler, keeper, human gap and exit rope within one coherent depth of field. The community and its passage custom are invented fictional circumstances.
